units.characteristics: self-examination; misplaced priorities; the unsatisfying labour
units.gist: THE GEM - 'CONSIDER YOUR WAYS' (x2); 'you have SOWN MUCH and HARVESTED LITTLE; you eat but NEVER HAVE ENOUGH... wages into a BAG WITH HOLES'; 'why? because of MY HOUSE that lies in ruins while EACH OF YOU BUSIES HIMSELF WITH HIS OWN HOUSE' - self-examination; effort that yields no satisfaction when God is put second; then obedience, the people FEARED the LORD, and 'I AM WITH YOU' + the LORD STIRRED UP THEIR SPIRIT

units.characteristics: encouragement to the discouraged; My Spirit remains; the greater glory and peace
units.gist: GEM - to those who saw the former glory and see this 'as nothing in your eyes': 'BE STRONG... WORK, FOR I AM WITH YOU... MY SPIRIT REMAINS IN YOUR MIDST. FEAR NOT'; 'the LATTER GLORY of this house shall be GREATER than the former... and in this place I will give PEACE' - the discouraged heart heartened by presence and Spirit, not by visible grandeur

units.characteristics: the contagion of uncleanness vs holiness; the defiled heart infecting its works
units.gist: GEM - the priestly ruling: holy meat does NOT make what it touches holy, but a corpse-defiled person DOES make what he touches unclean; 'SO IS IT WITH THIS PEOPLE... and so with EVERY WORK OF THEIR HANDS; what they offer is UNCLEAN' - uncleanness spreads, holiness doesn't; the defiled heart infects all its works; 'yet you did NOT TURN to me'; 'from this day on I WILL BLESS YOU'; the signet ring 'I have chosen you'
